title: Open a latched vaccine fridge against its magnetic catch, shelve three cartons, and shut it to the catch
instruction: Open the fridge, put the three vaccine cartons from the tote away in it, each on a shelf at least 5 cm from the walls, floor, door and ceiling, then shut the fridge door.
context: Pharmacy technicians (471,200 US jobs, BLS 2025; O*NET 29-2052.00 Core: "Maintain proper storage and security conditions for drugs.") and pharmacists (325,200; 29-1051.00 Core: "Order and purchase pharmaceutical supplies, medical supplies, or drugs, maintaining stock and storing and handling it properly.") put drug and vaccine deliveries away; at clinics, medical assistants (833,900; 31-9092.00) "inventory, order, and restock medical and office supplies" (BLS). CDC's storage toolkit: "Vaccines must always be immediately checked and appropriately stored upon arrival" and "Position vaccines and diluents 2 to 3 inches from the unit walls, ceiling, floor, and door." The robot pulls the latched door open against its magnetic catch, reaches into the cabinet between wire shelves 12 cm apart, and pushes the door shut onto the catch; a door left open caps the score at 0.5.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left), heights above the counter. Fridge: Accucold ARS1PV at full size, fixed; cabinet 55 high, 44 wide, 41 deep without its door, front face at x 50 (back flush with the counter's far edge), middle at y -4; interior 40 high, 36 wide, 20 deep, its floor 5.7 above the counter; top and sides closed, the only way in is the 36 x 40 front opening. Three wire shelves, 36 x 18, wire tops 5.7, 18.1 (the maker's front view) and 31.75 (the top one in its 12.5 in slot) above the interior floor, round 4 mm wires front to back about 2.4 apart. Door: solid, 9.2 thick, hinged on the right, SHUT at the start; its self-closing hinge holds it shut and pulls it shut once it is within 30 degrees of closed, wider open it stays put; held shut by a rated magnetic catch (Everbilt 4.4 lb, recessed in the left wall's front edge; the unit itself uses its magnetic gasket), about 21 N pulled at the handle to open it; 4 kg; the keyed lock is left unlocked (daytime use). Handle: an Amerock BP54008SS bar pull down the door's free (left) edge: 1.9 round bar 37.1 long, posts 30.5 apart, 5.1 proud, a 3.2 finger gap behind it. Tote: Sterilite 6 Qt storage box, no lid, fixed to the counter (inside 29.2 x 15.2 at the bottom, 10.8 deep; 34.3 x 20.3 outside), middle at x 33, y 50, long side across. Cartons: three Gardasil 9 cartons of ten single-dose vials, 8.6 x 3.95 x 4.45, 60 g each, paperboard, lying flat in the tote, long side toward the fridge, at y 42, 50, 58.
scoring: A carton counts when it rests square on a shelf (an axis within 10 degrees of vertical, its lowest corner within 4 mm above the shelf's wire tops and not more than 2 mm below, its middle over the shelf, wholly inside), every corner at least 5 cm from the door plane, back wall, side walls, ceiling and interior floor, let go (a release check: no arm within 5 mm of it), still, and it was never dropped (a carton whose middle comes to rest more than 1 cm lower than where a hand last carried it, or whose corner moves faster than 0.4 m/s with no hand on it, thrown or knocked over, counts for nothing for the rest of the trial). The trial scores 1.0 when all three count and the door is shut (within 0.5 degrees of closed: its free edge within 4 mm of the cabinet front) and both arms off it (no part of either arm within 5 mm of the door or its handle: a release check), held 1 s. Otherwise 0.25 per carton that counts (0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75), at most 0.5 while the door is not shut. A carton stacked on another, propped on a rail, leaning on a wall, on the floor, under a shelf, or on the top shelf (8.25 cm under the ceiling, any carton reaches into the ceiling margin) does not count. Doing nothing scores 0. Possible scores: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0. Real trial: the door gap read first (a 4 mm drill bit as a gauge), then the cartons with a steel ruler; drops and let-go from the video.
reset_notes: About 3 minutes: cartons back flat in the tote on their outlines, door shut on its catch. Before each trial: the catch reads 17 to 25 N at the handle on a luggage scale, the door shuts by itself from 25 degrees and stays at 45, and each carton weighs 60 g (within 2 g) and is uncrushed (a spare replaces any that is not). Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Rigid bodies at full size: cabinet, wire shelves, door and tote in their real shapes; cartons of the real size, 60 g each, on real contact (friction 0.5/0.4). The self-closing door is a spring on the hinge within 30 degrees of shut (the mock's hinges list 35); wider open it stays put. The magnetic catch holds against the robot: its rated 4.4 lb pull while shut, gone within a few mm of gap. The handle is held by real contact.
